name: team-harness
description: Configure, update, and run lightweight or gated Team Harness workflows in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Setup, updates, intake, and gated delivery.
interface.longDescription: Configure and update Team Harness natively in Codex, keep Main clean by default, use @Team-Harness init for lightweight intake and direct work, or explicitly request @Team-Harness pipeline for staged delivery backed by specialized agents.
defaultPrompt: @Team-Harness setup: configure Team Harness for Codex.
@Team-Harness update: update the Codex marketplace, plugin, configuration, and installed agents.
@Team-Harness init: help me frame or handle this task without starting the full pipeline.
@Team-Harness pipeline: explicitly start the full gated workflow for this change in the current Main thread.
Continue implementation of the active approved Team Harness pipeline.
Recover the active Team Harness workspace.
